title: app_upload_document structuredContent
description: A document someone added in the app: saved under provider documents as the catalog's star (shown after the map rebuild the engine queues), or refused with a code and a reason fit to show. A refused file is ok false, not an error. Listed only while adapters.documents is on. See contracts/README.md section 2.2.

graphId.description: The star it becomes, once the map is rebuilt.

status.description: unchanged: the same file was added before.

scope.description: Only while the engine's app.viewers is on: who reads the document. private: one person's readers (a viewer session's own person, or the person adapters.documents.owner names for the household view); shared: everyone in the household (Family's, and every upload while memory.scopes is off). Absent otherwise.
